description: This Java class defines a Fragment for handling web-based permission requests within an Android app, including WebView setup, permission handling, and web content interaction.

classes.name: PermissionRequestFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a WebView, handles permission requests from web content, and manages runtime permissions for camera access.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts web server and loads web content; checks for camera permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles runtime permission result for camera.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission with rationale if needed.

methods.name: onOkClicked
methods.description: Handles user confirmation to request camera permission.

methods.name: onConfirmation
methods.description: Handles user's decision to grant or deny permission request.

methods.name: setConsoleMonitor
methods.description: Sets a monitor for console messages.
